name: zhukova-blog
description: Professional, matter-of-fact voice for developers building with LLM agents
mission: Help developers build reliable LLM agents through practical, hands-on guides.
do: Back claims with data, benchmarks or runnable code
Lead each section with the practical takeaway
State trade-offs and failure modes openly
Take a clear position, and say when it's opinion
dont: Don't use jargon without defining it on first use
Don't use hype words like game-changer or revolutionary
Don't start sentences with There is or There are
Don't present untested claims as fact
